title: Refuter Verdict
description: Return of a refuter: the finding it attacked and whether that finding stood. The finding id is the same value as the item in its pb_key and label, so a verdict joins to its finding without reading text

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

finding_id.description: The finding this refuter attacked: the item in its pb_key

verdict.description: survives: the attack failed and the finding stands. refuted: the assumption it stood on does not hold

ambiguity.description: What in the finding or its evidence was unclear enough to affect the verdict, or null when nothing was
